These C/C++ fixtures were captured in separate temporary working directories with unchanged installed PyJoern 4.0.150.4 and Joern v4.0.150. Source and reference hashes are recorded in provenance.json. The JSON snapshots retain exact selected CFG node roles, directed edges, degeneracy, and coverage.

The controls distinguish inferred and declared type bindings, unknown annotation recovery, valid and malformed numeric/function declarators, repeated parameter lists, incomplete translation-unit declarations, and malformed escaped global initializers. Positive calling-convention, pointer, typedef, string-escape, nested-body, and following-method controls constrain recovery to the original CDT behavior. Malformed globals can consume the following function as part of the same problem declaration; that recovery is retained in both languages.

The source-backed declaration skip follows AbstractGNUSourceCodeParser.skipProblemDeclaration/skipToSemiOrClosingBrace from the bundled Eclipse CDT 8.4.0.202401242025 implementation. Full saved Dewolf getfacl and numfmt provenance remains in workspace/ged-reeval/probes; these fixtures are small language-shape reductions.

The logical_declaration_boundaries and reference_binding_boundaries pairs reduce the saved SSH Binja logical expression that was mistaken for a reference declaration. C keeps named-type `&`/`&&` forms as expressions. C++ retains genuine reference declarations and reference-return prototypes while resolving bound-name and invalid-declarator suffix ambiguities as expressions. Known and unknown pointer types, global and parameter bindings, multiplication, and bitwise expressions are positive controls. Their original AST labels and hashes are preserved in workspace/ged-reeval/probes/logical-declaration-boundaries/audit.json.

The qualified_pointer_binding_boundaries pair protects valid const/volatile pointer declarations, including record aliases and ordinary parameter/global name shadows. Pointer qualifiers make these declarations unambiguous. Bare bound-name pointer products remain expressions, while record alias pointer initializers remain declarations. The pair includes the exact declaration shapes from the two Crazyflie Astra strict-regression sites.
